summary: Frontend validation of the MULEH AR navigation HUD completed on the public Expo preview at mobile size. The HUD, viewfinder, assist arrow, all three visualization modes, recording start/stop states, and overflow behavior passed.
action_items: Add stable testID attributes to the mode controls and recording button for future native/web regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Interactive Pressable elements currently have no testID attributes, reducing reliable automated coverage.
The settings icon Pressable has no onPress behavior; this is outside the requested first-screen flow but should be wired or made clearly non-interactive in a later task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated at 375x667 using https://ngpk-dev-workflow.preview.emergentagent.com. Dots → Arrows → Pin → Dots switching passed; start and stop recording state transitions passed; document width equaled viewport width.
rca_of_issue: No requested-flow defects reproduced. Expo logs only showed compatibility advisories for expo and expo-constants patch versions; no runtime or blocking errors were observed during this validation.
